title: 补齐面边界与结构化运行协议

originalAcceptance.criterion: 导出契约有版本号与兼容策略。
正反样例测试覆盖合法、缺字段、非法事件和未知字段。
文档标注与 Codex exec 的差异。

boundaries: The protocol is a versioned display/CI envelope, not a new runtime event authority.
No Codex CLI compatibility layer, persistence, state-machine change or downstream implementation was added.
Invalid input fails closed with a structured error line and non-zero script exit.
All receipts are agent-driven; no real-human evidence is claimed.
